desc: Ideation: reachable set = all ordered trees with same unordered shape; answer = product over nodes of multinomial counts of child-subtree multisets (verified against samples: (())() → 2, () → 1).

Implement full solution: stack-based parse of S into forest with virtual root; bottom-up canonical labels (sorted tuple of child labels → id via dict); per-node multiplicity grouping; answer *= fact[k] * ∏ inv_fact[m] mod 998244353; precompute factorials/inverse factorials up to N; solve() reading stdin and writing stdout.
